tactical.explanation: In-memory session state from createState() in state.mjs: a `selection` ref and an insertion-ordered `bundle` Map. No file, no database — process memory only, shared same-process between the SPA API and the MCP bridge. See the behavioral traces for the full call chain.

anchors.note: closes over `let selection = null` + `const bundle = new Map()`; in-memory only, no persistence

fields.name: selectionNodeId
fields.derivation: The id of the single node the human last opened in the SPA (the detail panel), mirrored to the server via POST /api/selection -> state.setSelection(nodeId). This is what get_current_selection returns to a connected Claude session. Exactly one node at a time (the selection is a scalar ref, not a set); null before the first open and after clearSelection(). The POST rejects an unknown id (404) so the stored id always resolves to a node in agg-model.
fields.notes: Held in process memory as the `nodeId` of state.mjs `selection` ({ nodeId, at } | null); never written to disk. Set by POST /api/selection (server.mjs setSelection), read by get_current_selection.

evidence.note: selection = nodeId ? { nodeId, at: Date.now() } : null
POST /api/selection validates the id then state.setSelection(nodeId)

fields.name: selectionAt
fields.derivation: Epoch-ms wall-clock stamp (Date.now()) captured when the selection is set, alongside the nodeId in the `selection` object. It is recorded but NEVER surfaced: no API response, MCP tool, or renderer reads `at`, so there is no way to tell how old the selection is. This is exactly the blind spot behind hot-selection-never-cleared — closing the detail panel never clears the selection server-side, and because `at` is invisible a connected Claude session cannot detect that it is looking at a stale node.
fields.notes: Held in process memory as the `at` field of state.mjs `selection`; captured but unused (never projected). See hotspot hot-selection-never-cleared.

evidence.note: at: Date.now() stamped but never read back

fields.name: bundleItems
fields.derivation: The curated context bundle: an insertion-ordered set of typed refs { type, id, at } where type is one of node | flow | hotspot, so a whole flow ('the graph') can be gathered alongside individual nodes. Backed by a Map keyed by `${type}:${id}`, which gives the dedup invariant (addToBundle is set-if-absent) and preserves click order. getBundle() projects each entry down to { type, id } (dropping `at`). One bundle per PROCESS, not per session or per browser tab (see hot-bundle-single-global-state); survives an in-run browser reload only because the SPA re-hydrates it once on mount from GET /api/context.
fields.notes: Held in process memory as state.mjs `bundle` (Map<"type:id", { type, id, at }>); never persisted, lost on server restart. Mutated by addToBundle/removeFromBundle/clearBundle via /api/context; read by getBundle(). See hotspots hot-bundle-single-global-state.

evidence.note: const bundle = new Map() keyed by `${type}:${id}` -> { type, id, at }
insertion-ordered values projected to { type, id }

tactical.explanation: renderBundleMarkdown(services, items) in context.mjs projects the live bundle (state.getBundle()) into one grounded markdown document, computed lazily on read. Resolves each ref against agg-model and embeds real source excerpts. No storage of its own — a projection over agg-selection's bundle + agg-model. See the behavioral traces for the two channels (MCP resource + GET /api/context).

fields.name: items
fields.derivation: The resolved list of gathered refs the selected-nodes resource / GET /api/context returns: the live state.getBundle() output, an insertion-ordered array of { type, id } (type node | flow | hotspot). This is the machine-readable half of the payload (the SPA drawer lists them; the markdown field renders them). Assembled at read time from the shared in-memory bundle, not stored.
fields.notes: Read-time projection of agg-selection.bundleItems (state.mjs `bundle` via getBundle()); no store of its own. Returned by GET /api/context as `items`.

fields.name: markdown
fields.derivation: The rendered bundle document: each gathered node/flow/hotspot ref mapped through renderItemMarkdown -> buildNodeContext/buildFlowContext/buildHotspotContext then the matching renderer (descriptions, invariants, flows, real source anchors, and for flows a colored Mermaid graph), joined by '---'. Unresolved refs render '' and are dropped; an empty bundle yields a '_No items_' placeholder. COMPUTED ON READ (lazy) over agg-model + live source files (ext-source-fs via readSource) — never materialized on the add/remove event. Served identically over the MCP resource event-storming://selected-nodes and the SPA's GET /api/context 'Copy all' channel.
fields.notes: Computed by context.mjs renderBundleMarkdown at read time over agg-model + on-disk source excerpts; nothing persisted. It is a join of agg-selection.bundleItems against agg-model, not a field of any stored row.
